description: Who controls a Keeta token: owner, admins, who can mint, who can change permissions, where minted supply went. Not an audit. Returns the x402 payment quote for this read (price, network, asset, pay-to, and the exact URL). It does not return data. To buy, GET the returned URL over HTTP and pay with x402; check get_x402_health first.
name: quote_token_rules
